description: This file defines the JobParametersDTO class, which acts as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for passing job parameters within the Apache Fineract framework. It contains a set of JobParameterDTO objects encapsulating individual job parameter details.

classes.name: JobParametersDTO
classes.description: A data transfer object holding a set of job parameter DTOs for job configuration within the framework.

methods.name: JobParametersDTO
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the JobParametersDTO with a set of JobParameterDTO objects.
